articles.summary: DALLAS, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kosmos Energy Ltd. (“Kosmos” or the “Company”) (NYSE/LSE: KOS) announced today its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. For the quarter, the Company generated a net loss of $43 million, or $0.07 per diluted share. The post Kosmos Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results appeared first on Kosmos Energy .
articles.title: Kosmos Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
